title: An almost Kähler Cheeger--Gromoll splitting theorem with applications
summary: In this paper, we establish an almost Kähler analogue of the Cheeger--Gromoll splitting theorem for complete almost Kähler manifolds with nonnegative Ricci curvature. As applications, we use the splitting to obtain Goldberg-type integrability results and establish a relation between symplectic non-hyperbolicity and nonnegative Ricci curvature via a theorem of Bangert.
